"""Rebuild the complete original L1 target binding without importing CAD.

The original require() function and exact target-equality call are compiled
from the immutable producer AST. This is a metadata diagnosis, not geometry.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

OLD_BINDING_SHA = "fa5def368eb9d837ab31d8729d2ff5a5bb080b394392d228429f27375baf2fbf"
NEW_BINDING_SHA = "7de2b7f78e18de99a0c084e80e9fbd2a62582d1b6624b4f2ea031f37ccfda2f2"
PRODUCER_SHA = "c17c812f90a19ca98e37e99056c78607b57872adcb13aa52b4904d3086e62e12"
L1_ZIP_SHA = "3d7ca39ceec488ab4e8b4418831b3eb5f921dfad91bb597670fba84aee24160c"
CORE_SHA = "433b9f89f34ffca28123d767f02ae81572e68d282e95f020a600b1b31aa1d949"
GATE = "original exact case specification changed"
CASE_IDS = ["case-011", "case-012", "case-013", "case-014", "case-016", "case-017", "case-018"]
FIELDS = {"a", "b", "q_interval_exact", "pair_class", "specification"}


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--l1-zip", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--l5-source", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--s4-source", type=Path, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    before_modules = set(sys.modules)
    old_bytes = (args.l5_source / "L5_ORIGINAL_SEVEN_BINDING.json").read_bytes()
    require(digest(old_bytes) == OLD_BINDING_SHA, "old binding identity")
    old = json.loads(old_bytes)
    require([x["case_id"] for x in old["original_cases"]] == CASE_IDS, "original case set")
    archive = args.l1_zip.read_bytes()
    require(len(archive) == 7379877 and digest(archive) == L1_ZIP_SHA, "original ZIP identity")
    producer = (args.l5_source / "run_l5.py").read_bytes()
    require(digest(producer) == PRODUCER_SHA, "original producer identity")
    module = ast.parse(producer)
    function = next(x for x in module.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef) and x.name == "require")
    calls = [x for x in ast.walk(module) if isinstance(x, ast.Call) and
             isinstance(x.func, ast.Name) and x.func.id == "require" and len(x.args) == 2 and
             isinstance(x.args[1], ast.Constant) and x.args[1].value == GATE]
    require(len(calls) == 1, "one original equality gate")
    ns = {}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), "<original require AST>", "exec"), ns)
    gate_code = compile(ast.Expression(body=calls[0]), "<original exact target gate AST>", "eval")

    def original_gate(raw, target):
        try:
            eval(gate_code, ns, {"raw": raw, "row": {"target": target}})
        except ValueError as exc:
            require(str(exc) == GATE, "unexpected pure replay error")
            return False
        return True

    source_checks = []
    for name, identity in old["source_files"].items():
        data = (args.s4_source / name).read_bytes()
        require(len(data) == identity["bytes"] and digest(data) == identity["sha256"], "original S4 source identity")
        source_checks.append({"repository_path": name, **identity, "actual_bytes_verified": True})
    require(len(source_checks) == 11, "eleven original source files")
    core_bytes = (args.l5_source / "cylindrical_sweep_l5.py").read_bytes()
    require(digest(core_bytes) == CORE_SHA, "unchanged core identity")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(args.l5_source.resolve()))
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("replayed_l5_pure_core", args.l5_source / "cylindrical_sweep_l5.py")
    core = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(core)
    sections = core.source_sections(args.s4_source)
    new = copy.deepcopy(old)
    items = []
    for row in old["original_cases"]:
        items.append(row["original_result"])
        for material in row["inputs"]:
            items.extend(material["exports"].values())
    for material in old["original_EXTRUSION_direct_control"]["original_saved_materials"]:
        items.extend(material["exports"].values())
    require(len(items) == 39 and len({x["path"] for x in items}) == 39, "39 exact original files")
    checked_members = []
    rows = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.l1_zip) as z:
        require(len(set(z.namelist())) == len(z.namelist()), "duplicate archive member")
        require(z.testzip() is None, "original full archive CRC")
        for item in items:
            data = z.read(item["path"])
            require(len(data) == item["bytes"] and digest(data) == item["sha256"], "exact bound original member")
            checked_members.append({**item, "actual_bytes_verified": True})
        for old_row, new_row in zip(old["original_cases"], new["original_cases"]):
            raw = json.loads(z.read(old_row["original_result"]["path"]))
            full = raw["target"]
            require(set(old_row["target"]) == FIELDS and len(full) == 20, "original 5 versus 20 fields")
            require({k: full[k] for k in FIELDS} == old_row["target"], "all five scientific fields unchanged")
            require(full["case_id"] == old_row["case_id"], "original case identity")
            require(not original_gate(raw, old_row["target"]), "old incomplete binding must fail")
            require(original_gate(raw, full), "restored complete binding must pass original gate")
            old_plan = core.plan(old_row["target"], old_row["target"]["specification"], sections)
            new_plan = core.plan(full, full["specification"], sections)
            require(old_plan == new_plan, "all original pure plan fields unchanged")
            controls = []
            for field in ("material", "q_interval", "historical_node_sha"):
                bad = copy.deepcopy(full)
                if field == "material":
                    bad["specification"]["fixed"]["material"] += "_NEGATIVE_CONTROL"
                elif field == "q_interval":
                    bad["q_interval_exact"][1] = "11"
                else:
                    bad["original_node_sha256"] = "0" * 64
                require(not original_gate(raw, bad), "negative control accepted")
                controls.append({"mutation": field, "original_gate_rejected": True})
            new_row["target"] = copy.deepcopy(full)
            rows.append({
                "case_id": old_row["case_id"],
                "original_result": old_row["original_result"],
                "old_target_field_count": 5,
                "restored_original_target_field_count": 20,
                "restored_field_names": sorted(set(full) - FIELDS),
                "original_five_scientific_fields_unchanged": True,
                "original_exact_gate_with_old_binding_passed": False,
                "original_exact_gate_with_full_original_target_passed": True,
                "full_original_target_canonical_sha256": digest(canonical(full)),
                "old_projected_target_canonical_sha256": digest(canonical(old_row["target"])),
                "unchanged_pure_plan_canonical_sha256": digest(canonical(new_plan)),
                "negative_controls": controls,
                "native_executed": False,
            })
    revert = copy.deepcopy(new)
    for a, b in zip(revert["original_cases"], old["original_cases"]):
        a["target"] = copy.deepcopy(b["target"])
    require(revert == old, "binding changed outside seven targets")
    new_bytes = (json.dumps(new, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
    require(len(new_bytes) == 39348 and digest(new_bytes) == NEW_BINDING_SHA, "complete target reconstruction identity")
    require(not any(x == "cadquery" or x.startswith(("cadquery.", "OCP")) for x in set(sys.modules) - before_modules),
            "CAD module imported by pure replay")
    report = {
        "schema": "razr-L5b-original-target-binding-reconstruction-v2",
        "recovery_basis": "New byte-verified downloads of immutable public source commit and original L1 scientific ZIP; vanished local/RAM records were not recovered.",
        "source_commit": "33386f1d6046aee80b0446b9c21fb7c259c3523a",
        "source_tree": "c03bdbd891ba22902ab070ca9ab4c5ccfe39909f",
        "functional_commit": old["functional_commit"],
        "original_L1_artifact_id": 12605676028,
        "original_L1_ZIP_sha256": L1_ZIP_SHA,
        "original_L1_ZIP_bytes": len(archive),
        "all_original_ZIP_CRC_passed": True,
        "original_producer_sha256": PRODUCER_SHA,
        "original_gate_message_source_constant": GATE,
        "original_gate_AST_dump_sha256": digest(ast.dump(calls[0], include_attributes=False).encode()),
        "exact_original_AST_gate_used": True,
        "hosted_exception_text_recovered": False,
        "old_binding_sha256": OLD_BINDING_SHA,
        "new_binding_sha256": NEW_BINDING_SHA,
        "new_binding_bytes": len(new_bytes),
        "matches_pre_runtime_loss_reported_new_binding_identity": True,
        "previous_unpublished_request_recovered": False,
        "original_S4_source_files_verified": source_checks,
        "original_scientific_members_verified": checked_members,
        "cases": rows,
        "old_gate_failures_reproduced": len(rows),
        "new_original_gate_passes": len(rows),
        "unchanged_plan_cases": len(rows),
        "negative_controls_rejected": sum(len(r["negative_controls"]) for r in rows),
        "only_changed_binding_fields": ["original_cases[" + str(i) + "].target" for i in range(7)],
        "native_source_files_modified": 0,
        "original_equality_guard_modified": False,
        "native_CAD_executed": False,
        "native_geometry_cases_completed": 0,
        "full11781_verified": False,
        "physical_qualification": False,
        "candidate_go": False,
        "historical_original_raw_failure_and_fallback_clear_are_not_L5_results": True,
        "L5a_actual_run_id": 40289428756,
        "L5a_actual_native_started": False,
        "L5a_current_job_skipped": True,
        "remaining_original_nominal_cases_not_yet_evaluated": CASE_IDS,
    }
    (args.output / "L5_ORIGINAL_SEVEN_BINDING.json").write_bytes(new_bytes)
    out = args.output / "L5A_TARGET_BINDING_PURE_REPLAY.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"new_binding_bytes": len(new_bytes), "new_binding_sha256": digest(new_bytes),
                      "old_gate_failures": 7, "new_gate_passes": 7, "unchanged_plans": 7,
                      "negative_controls_rejected": 21, "report_sha256": digest(out.read_bytes()),
                      "CAD_executed": False}))

# L5b stage 1: restore the complete original target binding

This narrow change replaces only the seven `original_cases[i].target` values in the published L5 binding. Each replacement is the complete 20-field `target` read from its original L1 result. The original five scientific fields, whole-material input identities, source identities, q intervals, all specifications, and every other binding field are unchanged.

The immutable L5 producer requires exact dictionary equality with the original target. L5a run 40289428756 failed before its `native_started` flag: its binding had a five-field projection while the original result has twenty fields. The producer retained `ValueError` without its message. The precise failing gate is established here by compiling and running the unchanged producer's `require` and exact equality-call AST against the byte-verified originals; it is not represented as recovered hosted exception text.

The pure replay verifies the full 7,379,877-byte original E17 ZIP SHA and CRC, all 39 pinned scientific members, and all 11 pinned S4 source files. All seven incomplete targets fail the original gate; all seven complete targets pass it. The unchanged L5 pure plan is equal field for field for old and complete targets. All 21 negative controls (material, q interval, historical node identity) fail the original gate. No CAD module is imported and no native geometry is run.

The restored binding is exactly 39,348 bytes, SHA-256 `7de2b7f78e18de99a0c084e80e9fbd2a62582d1b6624b4f2ea031f37ccfda2f2`. This matches the identity reported before the old runtime disappeared. The old RAM script, report and unpublished request were not recovered; this reconstruction uses new exact readbacks of the fixed public Git sources and original artifact. The present script, replay report and request are newly generated and have their own identities.

The additional target fields contain original historical failure and fallback-clear records. They remain original history and are not L5 clear results. The earlier L5 workflow-size failure and L5a pre-native failure remain separate. All seven L5 native cases and the current-K1 stage remain unevaluated.

Stage 1 does not change a workflow, producer, algorithm, reader, threshold, process harness or resource guard. It does not request a native run. A later separately reviewed workflow can pin its source downloads to the immutable published stage-1 commit and update only the binding size/SHA.

Scope remains the seven original nominal q=[0,12] cases and their original specification. This does not cover the full factory binary64 acceptance slabs, the independent left/right domain, all 11,781 pairs, K3, OEM qualification or physical acceptance.

    installer,public=make_install(expected,binding)
    old_bodies=[];footers=[]
    for key in ("original","current"):
        run=old["jobs"][key]["steps"][2]["run"]
        a,b=body_span(run,MARKER);old_body=run[a:b];old_bodies.append(old_body)
        require("timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s python3 -B - <<'"+MARKER+"'" in run,"original transport cap")
        suffix=run[b:]
        require(suffix.count(OLD_BINDING_SHA)==1 and suffix.count("25013")==1,"single original identity footer pin")
        new_suffix=suffix.replace(OLD_BINDING_SHA,NEW_BINDING_SHA).replace("25013","39348")
        changed=run[:a]+installer+new_suffix
        aa,bb=body_span(changed,MARKER)
        restored=changed[:aa]+old_body+changed[bb:].replace(NEW_BINDING_SHA,OLD_BINDING_SHA).replace("39348","25013")
        require(restored==run,"prepare change outside source installer and binding identity footer")
        new["jobs"][key]["steps"][2]["run"]=changed
        f0,f1=body_span(changed,"L5_SOURCE_CHECK")
        footers.append(changed[f0:f1])
    require(old_bodies[0]==old_bodies[1] and footers[0]==footers[1],"both jobs have same transport and footer")
    # Native programs, all other steps, process ownership and resource fields must
    # be exactly the old values. Only source installation and top-level names move.
    restored=copy.deepcopy(new)
    for k in ("name","on","concurrency"):
        restored[k]=copy.deepcopy(old[k])
    for key in ("original","current"):
        restored["jobs"][key]["steps"][2]=copy.deepcopy(old["jobs"][key]["steps"][2])
    require(restored==old,"unexpected workflow semantic change")
    require(new["jobs"]["current"]["needs"]==old["jobs"]["current"]["needs"],"original current-stage prerequisite")
    require(all(x["timeout-minutes"]==40 for x in new["jobs"].values()),"original job time limit")
    output=yaml.safe_dump(new,sort_keys=False,width=100,allow_unicode=True).encode()
    require(len(output)<500000,"500KB workflow size guard")
    reparsed=yaml.safe_load(output)
    require(reparsed==new,"generated YAML round trip")
    shell_count=inline_count=0
    for job in reparsed["jobs"].values():
        for step in job["steps"]:
            if "run" not in step:
                continue
            run=step["run"]
            subprocess.run(["bash","-n"],input=run.encode(),check=True)
            shell_count+=1
            lines=run.splitlines()
            for i,line in enumerate(lines):
                m=re.search(r"\bpython(?:3)?(?: -B)? - <<'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)'$",line)
                if m:
                    end=next(j for j in range(i+1,len(lines)) if lines[j]==m.group(1))
                    ast.parse("\n".join(lines[i+1:end])+"\n",feature_version=(3,10))
                    inline_count+=1
    require(shell_count==19 and inline_count==11,"all original bash and Python blocks")
    for key in ("original","current"):
        run=reparsed["jobs"][key]["steps"][2]["run"];a,b=body_span(run,MARKER)
        require(run[a:b]==installer,"generated workflow installer differs from tested code")
    return output,installer,footers[0],public,{"bash_blocks_parsed":shell_count,"inline_python_3_10_blocks_parsed":inline_count,

        proc=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=100,check=False)
        require(proc.returncode==0,"bounded source installation failed")
        receipt=json.loads(proc.stdout)
        require(receipt["verified_public_source_count"]==20 and receipt["verified_public_download_bytes"]==193306 and
                receipt["installed_source_count"]==21 and receipt["installed_source_bytes"]==232654 and
                receipt["inline_binding_bytes"]==39348 and receipt["inline_binding_sha256"]==NEW_BINDING_SHA,
                "transport counters differ from exact payload")
        require(proc.stderr==b"","unexpected source installer diagnostic")
        for name,identity in expected.items():
            a=(host/"l5"/name).read_bytes();b=(case/"source/l5"/name).read_bytes()
            require(a==b and len(a)==identity["bytes"] and sha(a)==identity["sha256"],"two installed copies exact identity")
            installed[name]=a;checks.append({"name":name,**identity,"both_installed_copies_sha_and_bytes_verified":True})
        checked=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-c",footer],env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=15,check=False)
        require(checked.returncode==0 and checked.stderr==b"","original source footer rejected installed files")
        require(json.loads((case/"L5_SOURCE_IDENTITY.json").read_text())==expected,"original full source identity footer differs")
    # Test the exact new inline guard with one changed byte, before any network.
    module=ast.parse(installer)
    for node in module.body:
        if isinstance(node,ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.targets[0],ast.Name) and node.targets[0].id=="binding_raw":
            value=node.value.func.value
            require(isinstance(value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(value.value,str),"known inline UTF-8 literal AST")
            value.value="["+value.value[1:]
            break
    else:
        raise ValueError("inline binding AST assignment missing")
    bad_inline=compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(module),"<mutated inline binding control>","exec")
    network_calls=[]
    old_opener=urllib.request.build_opener
    old_env={k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ("HOST_ROOT","CASE_DIR")}
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="inline-negative-control-",dir=output) as tmp:
            host,case=make_test_dirs(Path(tmp))
            os.environ["HOST_ROOT"]=str(host);os.environ["CASE_DIR"]=str(case)
            def no_network(*args,**kwargs):
                network_calls.append("unexpected")
                raise AssertionError("unexpected network")
            urllib.request.build_opener=no_network
            try:
                exec(bad_inline,{})
            except ValueError as exc:
                require(str(exc)=="inline_complete_target_binding_bytes_differ","wrong negative-control gate")
            else:
                raise ValueError("mutated inline binding accepted")
            require(not network_calls and not list((host/"l5").iterdir()) and not list((case/"source/l5").iterdir()),
                    "invalid inline data wrote files or reached network")
        # Preserve the original public-source SHA gate with a same-length byte
        # mutation in the first source response. No network or native execution.
        public_calls=[]
        class Response:
            status=200
            def __init__(self,url):self.url=url
            def __enter__(self):return self
            def __exit__(self,*unused):return False
            def geturl(self):return self.url
            def read(self,n):
                name=self.url.rsplit("/",1)[1];data=installed[name]
                return (bytes([data[0]^1])+data[1:])[:n]
        class Opener:
            def open(self,req,timeout):
                public_calls.append(req.full_url)
                require(timeout==15,"original socket cap changed")
                return Response(req.full_url)
        urllib.request.build_opener=lambda *args,**kwargs:Opener()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="public-source-negative-control-",dir=output) as tmp:
            host,case=make_test_dirs(Path(tmp))

    finally:

# L5b inline fallback: complete target binding plus twenty fixed public files

This package is a reviewable source-transport fallback. It does not depend on an unconfirmed stage-1 commit. The complete original L1 target binding is embedded as exact UTF-8 data (39,348 bytes, SHA-256 7de2b7f78e18de99a0c084e80e9fbd2a62582d1b6624b4f2ea031f37ccfda2f2). Its SHA and byte count are checked before writing either source copy or contacting the public source endpoint. The other twenty files are fetched without credentials from immutable commit 33386f1d6046aee80b0446b9c21fb7c259c3523a, with their original SHA/size checks, rejected redirects, and the original 15 s socket timeout.

The installer remains inside the original 90 s process cap plus 5 s termination grace. It writes all twenty-one files to the same two external source directories. The original full twenty-one-file source footer runs afterward; only its binding SHA/size changes. The public download payload is 193,306 bytes; the exact installed source set is 232,654 bytes. No worker or host budget grows: 1800 s worker, 1536 MiB peak RSS, original shared-memory and disk gates, 2220 s host deadline, 40 min job. Original and current jobs remain sequential with the original dependency.

All seventeen native Python sources, K1 binding, method plan and method README remain byte-identical. Producer, core, original exact-target equality, signed volume, topology, conservatism controls, whole-pair 1e-7 sum, native controls and both readers are unchanged. All other workflow steps and job fields remain the original parsed values. The separately named workflow, push branch and concurrency identify this fallback. The generated YAML is below 500,000 bytes and all nineteen bash blocks and eleven embedded Python blocks parse.

Validation actually ran only the bounded standard-library source installer and original SHA footer in fresh temporary directories. It fetched the fixed twenty public files and checked both installed copies of all twenty-one files. A one-byte inline-binding mutation was rejected before network access or file writes. A same-length mutation in a simulated public response was rejected by the original SHA gate. Downloaded source was never imported or executed. No CAD, original L1 replay, producer or native reader was run.

The exact stage-1 request b9773dc610e30196957a71fea34f5daea9884e45a64473119924763a15554e4c and its five reviewed files are preserved. This tree request includes those files unchanged alongside the fallback workflow and transport evidence. The parent reported two interrupted publication attempts, a binding blob, a 404 branch and no confirmed L5b run. Blob presence alone establishes neither a commit nor a published branch. Both original preparation failures remain: initial L5 workflow size rejection and L5a pre-native target-binding mismatch. At freeze this package is blocked_by_unconfirmed_publication, with no new Git write.

Native evidence remains unmeasured for the seven original nominal q=[0,12] cases and their current-K1 counterparts. This transport work does not prove the full binary64 factory acceptance slabs, independent left/right domain, K3, all 11,781 pairs, OEM electrical qualification or physical G3–G5.
